newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin down one cent to 15.15 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin down one cent to 15.15 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price fell one cent to 15.15 ringgit ($6.05) a kg after active selling in tandem with a lower overnight close on the London Metal Exchange.
"There were high offerings at the open of the market and tin is still trading at a discount," said a dealer.

Turnover fell to 120 tonnes from 173 tonnes on Tuesday. Bids totalled 119 tonnes against offers of 131. Dealers said there was a discount of $15 a tonne against London, the same as Tuesday. Buyers were from Europe, Japan and Malaysia.
